metadata.Name: RuDSI
metadata.Description: RuDSI is a benchmark for word sense induction (WSI) in Russian. It was created by manually annotating semantic relatedness between word usages from the Russian National Corpus, building Word Usage Graphs (WUGs), and then semi-automatically clustering these graphs to induce data-driven senses.
Provider: National Research University Higher School of Economics
metadata.Paper Title: RuDSI: graph-based word sense induction dataset for Russian
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 60th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)
Affiliations: National Research University Higher School of Economics
metadata.Abstract: We present RuDSI, a new benchmark for word sense induction (WSI) in Russian. The dataset was created using manual annotation and semi-automatic clustering of Word Usage Graphs (WUGs). Unlike prior WSI datasets for Russian, RuDSI is completely data-driven (based on texts from Russian National Corpus), with no external word senses imposed on annotators. Depending on the parameters of graph clustering, different derivative datasets can be produced from raw annotation. We report the performance that several baseline WSI methods obtain on RuDSI and discuss possibilities for improving these scores.
